headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: Alchemy's documentation spans 7,661 crawled pages across a multi-project topology with 83.21% crawl coverage of the 10,215 discovered pages. API reference coverage is critically low at 16.67% despite 6,415 API pages detected, indicating significant gaps in usage documentation. Only 14.87% of pages display last-updated metadata, creating trust and staleness risk across 75.59% of content. Example code reliability is estimated at 70.19%, and overall retrieval readiness scores 69.77 (moderate band) with answerability at just 51.39%. The site has 11 confirmed broken internal links, all within user-facing docs.

key_findings.headline: Undocumented API operations
key_findings.business_consequence: Generate/update reference + how-to from OpenAPI and enforce drift checks.

key_findings.headline: Documentation freshness debt
key_findings.business_consequence: Prioritize stale pages via weekly SLA loop and lifecycle policies.

key_findings.headline: Code/docs contract drift
key_findings.business_consequence: Track interface changes and enforce docs updates with report-first governance.

priority_actions.title: Add last-updated timestamps to all 6,522 pages missing freshness metadata (85.13%) via automated git commit date injection
priority_actions.why_this_first: Low-effort metadata addition immediately signals content currency to 85% of users, reducing trust friction and enabling stale content triage.

priority_actions.title: Generate and backfill usage examples for the 5,348 API pages lacking coverage (83.33% gap) starting with top 200 most-visited endpoints
priority_actions.why_this_first: Closing the 16.67% API coverage gap directly unblocks developer onboarding and reduces support volume for the highest-traffic endpoints within 30 days.

priority_actions.title: Restructure the 3,735 pages with low answerability (48.61%) to include explicit Q&A sections, summaries, or structured headings
priority_actions.why_this_first: Improving answerability from 51.39% boosts AI assistant accuracy and search snippet quality, directly increasing self-service resolution rates.

strengths: High crawl coverage at 83.21% with 7,661 pages successfully indexed from 10,215 discovered
Strong citationability at 99.93% enables reliable source attribution for AI and search
Chunkability at 84.06% supports effective content segmentation for retrieval systems
risks: API reference coverage at 16.67% leaves 5,348+ API pages without adequate usage documentation, blocking developer onboarding
Answerability at 51.39% means nearly half of pages lack structure for direct question responses, degrading AI assistant and search quality
Freshness metadata missing on 85.13% of pages (6,522 pages) creates user trust issues and prevents stale content identification
Stale risk flagged on 75.59% of content (5,791 pages) without visible update signals, risking outdated guidance in production use
limitations: External audit cannot verify runtime correctness of the 70.19% example reliability estimate; actual code execution, dependency versions, and API behavior require live testing infrastructure.
Crawl coverage at 83.21% means 1,554 discovered pages were not examined; access restrictions, JavaScript rendering issues, or crawler traps may hide additional quality issues.

API coverage detection at 85% confidence may misclassify pages; the 16.67% reference coverage figure depends on heuristic detection of usage vs. reference content and may undercount embedded examples.
automation_first: Deploy git-based last-updated timestamp injection for the 6,522 pages (85.13%) missing freshness metadata, with weekly sync; expected payoff is immediate trust signal to users and automated identification of 5,791 stale-risk pages for review prioritization.

Implement CI/CD link validation to catch the 11 current broken internal links and prevent future link rot across 7,661 pages; expected payoff is zero-touch maintenance and preserved navigation integrity as the multi-project topology scales.

Build automated API reference cross-linker to surface the 5,348 undocumented API pages (83.33% gap) in usage guides and generate stub usage examples from OpenAPI specs; expected payoff is 3-5x faster coverage expansion and reduced manual documentation backlog for high-traffic endpoints.
